title: Revoking My Consent to Share Substance Use Disorder Records
about: Takes back a consent the patient signed under 42 CFR Part 2, in writing, as 2.31(a)(6) allows.

source.name: 42 CFR 2.31(a)(6), revoking a Part 2 consent in writing

licence.terms: GPL-3.0-or-later, as the module. Adapt it for your clinic.

blocks.text: I want to take back (revoke) my consent to share my substance use disorder treatment records.

blocks.label: Which consent
items: All of my consents to share these records

fields.label: Who it let share my records

blocks.text: I am revoking it in writing. It starts when {facility.name} gets this form. It does not undo anything already done because of my consent.
